title: Schedule of Submission Routes and Decision Timeframes — Referrals & Prior Authorizations
content:
For each Referrals & Prior Authorizations type, this schedule fixes who decides the request, the route by which it is sent, what must accompany it, and the timeframes for the decision and for telling the patient.

## Decision route and timeframes

| Referral type | Decided by the payer | Submission route | Standard decision (business days) | Urgent request allowed | Urgent decision (hours) | Patient told of decision (business days) |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| In-Group Specialist Referral | No (group specialty triage) | internal specialty scheduler | 3 | Yes | 24 | 2 |
| HMO Specialist Referral | Yes | payer portal | 5 | Yes | 72 | 2 |
| Standing Specialist Referral | Yes | payer portal | 7 | No | 72 | 2 |
| Out-of-Network Referral | Yes | payer fax | 10 | Yes | 72 | 3 |
| Physical Therapy Episode Authorization | Yes | payer portal | 3 | No | 72 | 2 |
| Advanced Imaging Prior Authorization | Yes | payer portal | 3 | Yes | 72 | 1 |
| Outpatient Procedure Prior Authorization | Yes | payer portal | 5 | Yes | 72 | 1 |

## What accompanies the request

| Referral type | Clinical notes | Signed out-of-network cost-share acknowledgement | Cost estimate given to the patient before first use | Referring clinician must be the primary care clinician of record |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| In-Group Specialist Referral | No | No | No | No |
| HMO Specialist Referral | No | No | No | Yes |
| Standing Specialist Referral | Yes | No | No | Yes |
| Out-of-Network Referral | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes |
| Physical Therapy Episode Authorization | Yes | No | No | No |
| Advanced Imaging Prior Authorization | Yes | No | Yes | No |
| Outpatient Procedure Prior Authorization | Yes | No | Yes | No |

## Units of time in this schedule

- **Business days** are Monday to Friday with group holidays excluded, counted from submission for the standard decision and from the decision for telling the patient.
- **Urgent decision hours** are elapsed hours from submission.
- Where a type is *not* decided by the payer, the group's own specialty triage decides it.

## Points of judgement

- *Does a Saturday count toward a standard decision timeframe?* No. A standard timeframe runs in business days, Monday to Friday, and group holidays are excluded as well.
- *Is an urgent timeframe listed for the Standing Specialist Referral and the Physical Therapy Episode Authorization?* The schedule lists 72 hours for both, and neither type may be requested as urgent.
- *Which route carries an Out-of-Network Referral?* The payer fax, and it goes with clinical notes and the patient's signed cost-share acknowledgement.
